The awaited result is consumed by the immediately following validation/preparation step; it is a data dependency. JsxStudioRunPanel awaits compilation before reading compiler diagnostics and prepared source. Moving this await later would access an unresolved compile result and cannot preserve diagnostic/preview ordering. Reassessed 2026-11-03: Default preview now fetches the block catalog and creates a contribution module loader, fenced by generation and disposed on revoke. Compilation/preparation still must finish before its diagnostics or component can be read.
